classification.difficultyReason: The student marks the interior angle at the middle letter of each name on a plain quadrilateral. There are no straight lines or interior rays to cross. This is a direct application of the angle-naming rule.

content.prompt: Draw an arc to show these angles on the diagram.

answer.worked: The middle letter gives vertex $K$. Draw the arc inside the quadrilateral between arms $KN$ and $KL$.
The middle letter gives vertex $L$. Draw the arc inside the quadrilateral between arms $LM$ and $LK$.
The middle letter gives vertex $M$. Draw the arc inside the quadrilateral between arms $ML$ and $MN$.
The middle letter gives vertex $N$. Draw the arc inside the quadrilateral between arms $NK$ and $NM$.
